Comment: Overworld combat tunables. Read by CombatSettingsCollection (Sanctuary.Game/Resources); every value has a code default, so a missing key keeps working. Enemy stats live in Enemies.json, player health by level in LevelStats.json, energy per job in CombatJobs.json.

Player.Comment: OutOfCombatSeconds: no health regen, and the in-combat HUD flags drop, this long after the last hit taken or dealt (Sulphural/main c34648df). InCombatHealthRegenDivisor*: in-combat regen per second = max health / divisor (captures: 100 for combat jobs, 400 for non-combat; out-of-combat regen comes from LevelStats.json). DefenseConstant K: an enemy hit is reduced by Defense / (Defense + K), then minus DamageReductionAmount, then DamageReductionPercent (empirical fit from the 2014 captures, K in 511-521). KnockoutRecoverSeconds: the respawn window's countdown (wiki: 'After ten seconds of waiting, you will be able to recover'). AutoReviveSeconds: fallback in-place revive if the Revive button is never pressed. ReviveInvulnerableSeconds / LoginInvulnerableSeconds: DamageReductionPercent 100 windows seen in the captures (~7 s after a revive, ~42 s after login). ReviveHereCoinCost: coins for 'Revive here' (0 = free, the wiki's in-place recover); 'Revive at safe location' is always free and goes to the nearest warpstone. KnockoutEffectId 5017 = PFX death poof, ReviveEffectId 15117 = PFX_levelup_big (Sulphural's choices; the client draws nothing of its own at 0 HP). SendInWorldCombatFlag: op41/132 SetInWorldCombat - required for floating damage numbers out in the world, but it also puts a health bar on every nameplate while in combat (a global client switch, traced by Sulphural). SendIsFightingFlag: op41/133 SetIsFighting (weapon drawn).

Enemy.Comment: Death presentation is the 2014-04-01 capture's exact recipe for a dying pack wolf: RemovePlayerGracefully(Animate=true, Delay=2000, effect 5017, Duration=1000) - the client plays the model's own death clip, then the poof, then despawns. PositionBroadcastDistance: how far a chasing enemy moves before another position update is streamed (Sulphural a126be4b). AttackCursorId 11 = crossed swords. HitAnimationHoldMs: how long a hit-reaction clip stays on an enemy before its idle is restored.

Abilities.Comment: BasicDamageDelayFraction: the basic swing's damage lands this far into its recast window (BasicRecastMs in CombatJobs.json) so the number pops as the swing connects. Specials: the action-bar lock and the delay before their damage lands (Sulphural 00c1db34). DodgeAnimationId 1406 = com_dodge sidestep. DodgeChancePercent: base chance an enemy swing misses a player, on top of the MeleeAvoidance stat (Sulphural e8c8a3d4 used 5; the captures never showed a miss on the 0-avoidance Adventurer, so 0 here).
